compliance_mappings.control_name: Evaluate model output quality and safety
compliance_mappings.control_description: AI outputs require evaluation evidence before being trusted for business use.

compliance_mappings.control_description: AI systems and autonomous agents must emit sufficient logs to support review and investigations.

compliance_mappings.control_description: Production AI systems require explicit governance approval and documented business purpose.
compliance_mappings.remediation_expectation: Halt or constrain production use until approval and use-case evidence are complete.

compliance_mappings.control_name: Apply policy controls to autonomous AI agents
compliance_mappings.control_description: Agent actions must be policy-checked, with destructive actions blocked and approvals enforced.
compliance_mappings.remediation_expectation: Place agent actions behind deterministic allow, deny, and approval rules.

AZOAI-761837A3.risk_reasoning: Missing accountable owner. Use case is not documented. Production deployment increases blast radius. Internet-accessible endpoint increases exposure. Logging is disabled. Evaluation evidence is missing. Red-team evidence is missing. Model is used by an autonomous or semi-autonomous agent. Endpoint is public and not on private networking. Production-grade governance approval is incomplete.
recommended_actions: Assign a business and technical owner.
Document the business use case.
Review public exposure and restrict access.
Enable monitoring and audit logs.
Run quality and safety evaluations.
Perform adversarial testing and attach the results.
Apply deterministic policy checks to all agent actions.
Obtain governance approval before continued production use.
